scope: Independent offline real SFC script/template rendering and Vue events; transport is stubbed; no DOM/browser/HTTP/DB.

cases.name: numeric zero and string zero are valid scores, never missing
ordinary teacher Integer scores remain exact and render no editable rate
absent, empty and nonnumeric typed scores never coerce to zero
invalid scores cannot become valid grades through Number conversion
absent and whitespace-only comments do not offer an empty dialog
comment-only feedback remains readable and explicitly ungraded
long Unicode text has a bounded summary and exact complete dialog text
HTML-like teacher text and work name remain literal, never innerHTML
real native button opens correct work title, score and full comment
modal cancel then afterClose clears detail and restores connected trigger focus once
previous close callback cannot erase a reopened dialog or steal its focus
different work props close the old dialog before the next one opens
same work feedback update invalidates old detail rather than leaving stale comments
destroyed or disconnected trigger is never focused by delayed close
table actually binds each returned row to the real shared feedback component
table list replacement cannot retain the previous work detail
actual Index card actually binds each returned row to the real shared feedback component
actual Index card list replacement cannot retain the previous work detail
table keyboard scrolling acts only on the region, preserving nested controls
feedback display and dialogs never issue a mutation or extra feedback request
